tagline: India's capital blends Mughal monuments like the Red Fort, Humayun's Tomb and Qutub Minar with India Gate, grand boulevards and the bazaars of Old Delhi.
overview: New Delhi is the capital of India, part of the vast Delhi metropolitan area on the Yamuna River. The British planned it in the 1910s and 1920s with architects Edwin Lutyens and Herbert Baker, and it became the capital in 1931. Its centre has wide avenues, the Rashtrapati Bhavan presidential palace and the India Gate war memorial.

Delhi has been the seat of empires for centuries. Three UNESCO World Heritage Sites stand here: the Red Fort, built by Shah Jahan; Humayun's Tomb, an early model for the Taj Mahal; and the Qutub Minar, a soaring 13th-century minaret.

In Old Delhi, the Chandni Chowk bazaar and the Jama Masjid, one of India's largest mosques, sit a short ride from the Lotus Temple and the Akshardham complex. Delhi is famous for its food, from parathas and chaat to butter chicken, and is the usual start of the Golden Triangle route to Agra and Jaipur.

funFacts.title: A PLANNED CAPITAL
funFacts.text: New Delhi was designed by Edwin Lutyens and Herbert Baker and became the capital in 1931.

funFacts.title: THREE UNESCO SITES
funFacts.text: The Red Fort, Humayun's Tomb and the Qutub Minar are all UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

funFacts.title: A TOWERING MINARET
funFacts.text: The Qutub Minar, begun around 1200, is about 73 metres tall.

funFacts.title: SHAH JAHAN'S FORT
funFacts.text: The Red Fort was built by Shah Jahan, who also built the Taj Mahal.

funFacts.title: A TAJ MAHAL FORERUNNER
funFacts.text: Humayun's Tomb inspired later Mughal tombs, including the Taj Mahal.

funFacts.title: WAR MEMORIAL
funFacts.text: India Gate honours Indian soldiers who died in the First World War.

funFacts.title: A RUST-FREE PILLAR
funFacts.text: The Iron Pillar at the Qutub complex has resisted rust for over 1,600 years.

funFacts.title: HUGE MOSQUE
funFacts.text: The Jama Masjid in Old Delhi is one of the largest mosques in India.

funFacts.title: LOTUS TEMPLE
funFacts.text: The Bahá'í Lotus Temple is shaped like a lotus flower with 27 marble petals.

funFacts.title: GOLDEN TRIANGLE
